info.title: API.SH: Tumblr
info.description: The Tumblr API from API.SH: public Tumblr data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A public Tumblr blog: name, title, description, avatar, header image, top tags, creation date, and its latest posts (about 10-20). Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for older posts (those come from the blog's own pages and carry id, link, date, summary, text, images and tags, without note counts). Each post: id, link and short link, date, type, summary, text, images, videos, links, audio, tags, notes, likes, reblogs, replies, NSFW flag and the reblog trail. Optional filters: `tag` reads the blog's own tag page; `type`, `before`, `after` and `limit` narrow the posts returned. Each post also has `reblog_trail` (each earlier post in the reblog chain with blog, post id, link, date, text and media), `reblogged_from_post` and `reblogged_root` (blog, post id, link).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tumblr-blog

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A blog link (tumblr.com/<name> or <name>.tumblr.com), instead of `blog`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` from the previous response for older posts (null when there are no more).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only the blog's posts with this tag (not with cursor).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only posts before this time (YYYY-MM-DD, ISO time or unix time).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Only posts at or after this time (YYYY-MM-DD, ISO time or unix time).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One public Tumblr post by link (or blog + id): text, images, videos, links, tags, notes, likes, reblogs, replies, reblog trail, date and the blog's profile. Also `reblog_trail` (each earlier post in the reblog chain, oldest first: blog, blog title, post id, link, date, text, images, videos, links), `reblogged_from_post` and `reblogged_root` (the post it was reblogged from and the original post: blog, post id, link).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tumblr-post

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The notes on a Tumblr post: likes, reblogs (with the reblogging blog, added text and tags) and replies, newest first, with the totals of each. Filter with `mode`; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tumblr-post-notes

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Post link in any form (or blog and id).

parameters.name: blog
parameters.description: Blog name, with id instead of url.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Post id, with blog instead of url.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Tumblr posts matching a search, as tumblr.com shows them to logged-out visitors (the first page, about 15-20 posts): text, images, videos, links, tags, note, like and reblog counts, the blog and the reblog trail, plus the related communities (name, members, tags) and related tags Tumblr shows beside the results. Filter by post type and by how recent posts are; sort by top or recent. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/tumblr-search

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Only posts from the last N days (0 = all time).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: Logged out, Tumblr shows the first page of a search (about 15-20 posts).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
